characters.name: As a Group
characters.description: Above Good and Evil: A rare heroic example, they may begood and honorable peoplewhodon't engage in traditional acts of piracyandoften do the right thing wherever they go, but for most of them, labels of "good" and "evil" generally don't matter. Granted, this is less about morality, and more about the expectational norms of those labels and what is considered good or bad. It's evident right from the beginning of the series, although various crew members took some time to get used to the label of "pirate".Zoro: Pirates are scum! Who would want to be one?Luffy: Does it matter? You're known as an evil pirate hunter. Achievements in Ignorance: A critical key component to the crew's ever-rising infamy and success is how they manage to perform feats of daring that defy the imaginations of many, while they themselves are oblivious to the magnitude of theImpossible Tasksthey undertake.The formation of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet happens entirely without Luffy's intention. At the end of the Dressrosa arc, the group found thatthey all like working with one anotherand they all have a mutual respect and admiration towards Luffy, who saved their lives and inspired them. Despite Luffy's protest, they all pledge themselves to him and decide to declare themselves as a member of his Fleet without his actual approval. The side effect of this ends up tipping the power scale of the universe and increasing the Straw Hats' infamy.Luffy becomes the "Fifth Emperor" of the Sea without even aiming for it. The crew's entry into Big Mom's territory is supposed to be a discreet rescue mission for Sanji; circumstances cause the situation to escalate, which leads to an assassination attempt on Big Mom because Sanji refuses to abandon his biological family to their fates by the Big Mom Pirates' hands. The ensuing chaos that results from the Big Mom Pirates chasing them down is then sensationalized by "Big News" Morgans, who declares Luffy to be the "Fifth Emperor" of the Sea. characters.name: "Iron Man" Franky
characters.description: Franky, real name Cutty Flam, is initially the leader of the Franky Family, a gang of villainous dismantlers living in Water 7 who provoke the Straw Hats' wrath by mugging Usopp and stealing most of their money. But after fighting againstCP9together, he soon becomes friends with the other Straw Hats and becomes the crew's shipwright. His eccentric behavior (SUUUPPERRR!!) and habit of wearing very little other then his trusty speedos lead many to brand him a pervert (which he takes pride in), yet he is loyal and protective of his friends, often calling them his "little bros". He's also prone to striking poses and breaking out intotorrents of tearsat the slightest hint of anything sentimental. As his epithet implies, he is a cyborg known asBF-36(BF = Battle Franky) due to being hit by a sea train, then washing up on a scrap yard and using said scrap to modify his body to keep from dying. He later uses blueprints from the world's best scientist to upgrade himself toBF-37during theTime Skip.His past is tied to Nico Robin's, as while she can read the location of the superweapon Pluton, he owns the blueprints themselves, with the plans having been passed down among the shipwrights of Water 7 for generations. After the World Government captures him along with Robin, he burns the blueprints and fights alongside the rest of the Straw Hats to save her. After the Straw Hats blackmail him through theft of his speedos at the end of the arc, he officially joins the crew.His dream is to build and sail on what he deems the greatest sailing ship on the seas, which results in the construction of the Straw Hats' new ship, theThousand Sunny.He has a bounty of 394,000,000 berries.noteHis first bounty of 44,000,000 is for his involvement in the Enies Lobby incident and his burning of the Pluton blueprints; it raises to 94,000,000 for his defeat of Señor Pink in Dressrosa. It raises to 394,000,000 for his defeat of Sasaki in Wano and becoming one of the senior officers within one of the F

characters.name: "First Son of the Sea" Jimbei
characters.description: The last of the Seven Warlords to be formally introduced, and the 10th member and helmsman of the Straw Hat Pirates. Jimbei is a whale-sharkFish-manand the former captain of the Pirates of the Sun after the death of Fisher Tiger. His becoming a Warlord eight years before the events of the main story saw the crew split up, with one faction headed by Arlong. Unlike Arlong, Jimbei's time with the Sun Pirates changed him for the better, as his dream is to have peace between humans and fishmen. He is also the series' most skilled practitioner ofFish-man Karate.He's first seen locked away in Impel Down due to his protesting the execution of Ace. Jimbei feels indebted to Whitebeard and his crew, thanks to Whitebeard's putting Fish-Man Island under his protection from marauding slavers, and has a friendship with Ace, despite fighting with him in the past. Luffy ends up setting him free, and the two work closely together to rescue Ace.Two years later, Luffy and Jimbei meet again on Fish-Man Island. Having gotten close to him during the ordeal there, and as well as their previous encounter in the Paramount War, Luffy asked him to join his crew. However, Jimbei turned him down for the time being, stating that he had some unfinished business to attend to. That business was severing his ties with the Big Mom Pirates, which he does eventually do, and later meets up with Luffy and company in the midst of doing so, helping to arrange the necessary players to crash Charlotte Linlin's tea party so they could rescue Sanji from harm. He left his captaincy of the Sun Pirates to Aladdin and Praline, with the intention of fully joining up with Luffy at the end of this situation. He does indeed join the crew as their official Helmsman, but as Big Mom and her crew bear down on them, he stays behind to help Aladdin and the Sun Pirates escape, with Luffy giving him captain's orders to survive and rendezvous with them in Wano Country. characters.name: Going Merry
characters.description: The Straw Hat Crew's first ship, a caravel-class ship designed by Merry in the East Blue, which later becomes a gift that Kaya gives to the Straw Hats as a reward for taking out Captain Kuro and his Black Cat Pirates. Over time, the crew come to love the ship as a home and as a friend, so much so that it literally takes on a life of its own and becomes just as much a part of the crew as any of them. Animal Motifs: Sheep. Sheep are symbols of purity and loyalty, traits thatMerrycertainly has as a member of the Straw Hat pirates. Because she has ram horns, rams can apply as well, as they symbolize fearlessness — when it comes to helping her friends,Merrycan be quite theDeterminator. Anthropomorphic Personification:Merry'sKlabautermann, a ghostly manifestation of a ship's spirit that isborn out of its crew's love for it. Unfortunately, a Klabautermann being seen by its crew is a sign that their ship will soon meet its doom;Merry'sgets seen in the middle of the Skypiea Arc, and true to form, she is immobilized due to accumulated,terminaldamage to her keel once the Straw Hats reached Water 7 at the beginning of the Enies Lobby Arc, and by the end of the arc she is finally laid to rest.The special for her reveals she lives on in the form of the Klabautermann, quietly and cheerfully watching over her crew on theThousand Sunny. The special for her reveals she lives on in the form of the Klabautermann, quietly and cheerfully watching over her crew on theThousand Sunny. Astonishingly Appropriate Appearance: She was reconfigured to look like a chicken after being made able to fly. Unfortunately, the wings broke almost immediately and the rest of the modifications apart from the braces used to repair where Bellamy trashed her were removed by the Klabautermann, who decided to return to her old look.

characters.name: Thousand Sunny
characters.description: The second ship of the Straw Hat crew, built after theGoing Merrywas destroyed. It is a brigantine-type ship designed and built by Franky with help from Yokozuna, Iceburg, and the remaining Galley-La foremen. Built from Adam Wood, it is a magnificent ship of the finest craftsmanship, at least double the size of theGoing Merry. Its features include practically all of the Straw Hats' various requests before arriving in Water 7. Animal Motifs: The Sunny figurehead is the head of a lion. Lions have long been associated with courage, nobility, royalty, strength, stateliness, and valour due to their historical reputation as the "king of beasts". Apology Gift: Franky states that since the Adam Wood material needed to build the ship was bought using the money he stole from the Straw Hats, theThousand Sunnyis already theirs the moment it is built. There are implications that it is also his way of apologizing for all the trouble he caused the crew. Blow You Away: The Coup de Burst and Gaon Cannon are powerful blasts of air (similar to Franky's Coup de Vent), allowing it fly into the air or fire aWave-Motion Gun. Cool Ship: TheThousand Sunnyis one of the most advanced ships on the Grand Line— its features include multiple mini-vehicles, aWave-Motion Gun, a rear-mounted thruster that can temporarily send the ship airborne, a propelling "lion's mane" that allows it to swim backwards, and a nearly impenetrable hull.

characters.name: Gear Five
characters.description: 11th-Hour Superpower: Luffy taking Kaido's full-strength blow straight-on when he is on his last legs apparently straight-upkillshim, with the SFX around his body indicating absolute silence as his heart has stopped. Luffy notes that, even if he is alive, he has no strength left to continue the fight. The narration even officially counts Kaido as the victor in their rooftop brawl. However, his Awakening revives him with an energetic grin on his face, ready to continue the fight with renewed vigour. Not only that, it further empowers his strength and abilities to new heights, allows Luffy to easily grow his hands to Gear Three's size without needing to blow air into his bones, and also rubberize the environment around him, allowing him to turn a section of floor into a shield that reflects Kaido's Blast Breath right back at him. Ability Mixing: As the apex of what Luffy's powers are capable of, Gear Five contains traits and abilities from all of his Gears. Luffy gains the smoky shroud over his shoulders and similar wavyFlaming Hairfrom his Gear Four Snake-Man form, is uncontrollably bouncing up and down all the time thanks to rubberising the immediate environment around him like a trampoline like 'Bounce-Man', has greater control over and free usage of his Sizeshifter powers from Gear Three, and activates this new Gear Five through Gear two's blood-pump mechanics, speeding up his heartbeat until it reachesthe appropriate tempo. Achievements in Ignorance: Luffy unknowingly comes across a surprising revelation about his Devil Fruit, the Human-Human Fruit Model: Nika. The World Government has covertly altered its name and classification to the Gum-Gum Fruit,downplaying its importance to the public. However, after unintentionally ingesting it, Luffy cleverly exploits its abilities and learns that the key to unleashingits full potential lies in imagination. characters.name: # — B
characters.description: #1 Dime: His trademark straw hat is a gift from his idol Shanks, and he treasures it to the point where if he gives it to someone else, it's really saying something, and so far he has only given it to Nami and Usopp. Likewise, if someone ever dares damage it, ass will be kicked in great quantities. When he gets struck hard withHeroic BSoDduring Marineford arc, he gets so distraught that he doesn't even realize that his hat fell down; Shanks finds it and then tells Buggy to give it back to Luffy. Its importance was elevated when a flashback revealedthat the hat may have belonged to Gold Roger himself. Ability Mixing: Luffy's Gear Four is a masterwork combination of his Devil Fruit powers, specifically both his gears, and Haki. Aside from being a visual send-off to Nightmare Luffy, it combines both Gear Two's speed with Gear Three's raw power. The variations are even either tougher (like Tank-Man, which makes him nigh immovable but super durable and capable of hitting back with immense power) or faster (like Snake-Man, which trades some defense for a vast increase in attack speed). Accidental Misnaming: He's prone to getting some people's names wrong when he first meets them. For instance, Hancock becomes "Hammock", Cavendish become "Cabbage" and Bonney becomes "Boggy". Although he makes a point to remember the latter's name as a sign of respect. The Ace:Throughout his journey to become the Pirate King, Luffy achieves incredible feats, solidifying his status as a powerful pirate in just over two years. He inspires others to pursue their dreams with determination and passion.He establishes his strength and skill by defeating notorious enemies like the Arlong Pirates and multiple Warlords. He proves himself to be a force to be reckoned with in theOne Pieceworld. Furthermore, he showcases his remarkable resilience and determination by surviving and influencing the intense Marineford conflict, emerging from it more infamous than ever.In his pursuit of greater power, Luffy

characters.name: # - F
characters.description: 10-Minute Retirement: In theCP9saga, he resigns from the Straw Hat Crew because of Luffy's decision to get a new ship which Usopp wasvehementlyagainst. He returns to the group after giving a heartfelt apology for his actions. Abnormal Ammo:It was one thing to be shooting hot sauce and gas bombs, among other things.Now he's shooting seeds which instantly grow into man-eating plants.He defeatsSugar a second timeby shooting a bizarre capsule-like contraption that opens up to reveal a drawing of himself doing a recreation of their previous fight, causing her to faint. It was one thing to be shooting hot sauce and gas bombs, among other things.Now he's shooting seeds which instantly grow into man-eating plants. He defeatsSugar a second timeby shooting a bizarre capsule-like contraption that opens up to reveal a drawing of himself doing a recreation of their previous fight, causing her to faint. Achilles in His Tent: Water 7 and Enies Lobby, as a result of Luffy changing ships andfeeling that he'll always lag behind the others. However, he is disguised as Sogeking, steps out of his tent and stops the main villain of the whole arc, allowing Franky to free Robin and finish the job together.

characters.name: # - C
characters.description: '90s Hair: His iconic "curtains" hairstyle is distinctly 90s, no doubt due to being officially inspired bySteve Buscemi'shairinReservoir Dogsaccording to Oda. This is Downplayed with art evolution and the Timeskip, however, with Sanji's hair becoming distinctly shaggier over time. Ability Mixing: In Wano, befitting the role of as cook, Sanji mixes his abilities together to get aNext Tier Power-Upas combines his Armament Haki, Diable Jambe and exoskeleton together to create Ifrit Jambe which turns his previous difficult fight with Queen into a cakewalk. Achievements in Ignorance: Sanji has repeatedly shown that he's actually really good at charming women when he's not intentionally trying to, Viola and Pudding being notable examples. Adaptational Badass: Downplayed. The sixth OP, Brand New World, shows Sanji matching Kalifa blow-for-blow at Enies Lobby, but in the manga, he loses the fight horribly, partly due to Kalifa's Soap-Soap Fruit, but mostly due to hisWouldn't Hit a Girlattitude. Played straight in the Wano anime with his fight against X-Drake, in the manga it was inclusive with Drake dominating. In the anime Sanji is able to KO the Supernova. Adaptational Jerkass: A minor variant. When he tells Jinbei to kill himself in the manga, it is in a fit of rage, but in the anime, he has a much calmer and firmer demeanor when saying it. A rare case where being calmer actually makes a character come off as harsher, since this makes hisSuicide Daresound more sincere rather than just him impulsively blurting it out from a loss of temper.

characters.name: In General
characters.description: Achilles' Heel: Implied — In battle, the Elders' main showcase of their strength isshrugging off severe injuriesthat wouldat leastkill anybody else, butthe old scars on their bodiesimply thereisa way around the absurdly powerfulHealing Factorof the Elders. Assuming, of course, those scars don't pre-date being given the role by Imu. Luffy and Bonney'sCombination Attackon Saturndoesknock the elder unconscious for a time and hisHealing Factorslows down, implying there'ssomekind of limit. It is later revealed thatConqueror's Haki is able to negate theHealing Factorbestowed by Imu but the Elders have defense of their own so only Conqueror's Haki on the level of Joyboy can do significant damage All for Nothing:They go to great lengths to silence Vegapunk and prevent him leaking the truth of the Void Century for their own ends, only for Vegapunk to pull aThanatos Gambiton them and leak the info anyway. As a result, the World Government annihilates Egghead for nothing, and York's dream of becoming a Celestial Dragon remains out of reach. They also lose access to Punk Records thanks to Edison and the other Satellites lifting the structure from Egghead. Furthermore, it's later revealed Lilith smuggled a perfect clone of Vegapunk off Egghead, implying eventhatwon't stick. Ambiguously Human: While they appear to be Awakened Mythical Zoan users based on the tell-tale black smoke ring around their animal forms, several other aspects of them do not fit into that mold.They seemingly don't age, have an incredibly varied and shared powerset by the standards of most Devil Fruits, aHealing Factorbordering on magic, and their transformations being introduced without the usual full Devil Fruit name all call into question if the Five Elders are actually Zoan users or simply beings whose powers are quite similar to them. characters.name: "White Knight" Cavendish
characters.description: A Super Rookie and the captain of the Beautiful Pirates, Cavendish is an incredibly pretty-looking young man who dresses like a dandy cavalier. He made a name for himself after he made it to the New World, but after the events of the Battle of Marineford and being overshadowed by the rookies of the "Worst Generation", he holds a grudge against Luffy and the other Supernovas for stealing his spotlight away from him. He enters the Corrida Colosseum hoping to win the Flame-Flame Fruit.Underlying the vain exterior of Cavendish is a radically different second personality, "Hakuba", a demon-minded killer. It tries to awaken whenever he sleeps, which causes Cavendish to suffer from narcolepsy and lethal sleepwalking. Hakuba is a blindingly fast, hellacious, and utterly bloodthirsty monster who cuts down everything he sees, responsible for a horrible series of massacres in the faraway Rommel Kingdom. It was because of this everyone believed it was the wind that was slashing people, and the phenomenon became known as the "Kamaitachi (Slicing Winds) of Rommel". Cavendish is often besieged by Hakuba's attempts to take over and must wrestle for control over his own body with his psychotic other self.Despite his grudge against the Worst Generation, once turned into a toy by Sugar, he quickly allies himself with Luffy after Usopp frees him.He has a bounty of 330,000,000 Berries. After Doflamingo's defeat, he and his crew become (through lottery) the 1st division of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet. It's only fitting that the person who loves the spotlight the most ends up being number one. Agent Peacock: When you are able to tank a headbutt from a pirate who once fought evenly withGarp, with a sword thinner than one of said pirate's locks of hair, you have earned your place in the New World. Hakuba is even tougher than him! Always a Bigger Fish: Delinger is doing a fine job in the fight, but Hakuba showing up overwhelms him without issue. Animal Motifs: Horses. His main companion is a w

characters.name: Suleiman "The Beheader"
characters.description: An A-rank war criminal who participates in the Corrida Colosseum tournament. He eventually joins the Beautiful Pirates, under Cavendish, despite not being quite beautiful.He has a bounty of 67,000,000 Berries. Badass Normal: He's a powerful fighter with no devil fruit. Commonality Connection: Suleiman seems to connect to people who have suffered what he has. He is sympathetic to Rebecca over how Dressrosa has turned on her and later bonds with Cavendish as both are exiles from their homes. Curb-Stomp Battle: He's the first member of the alliance to be defeated by Dellinger, after he got stabbed by the psycho's horns. Cynicism Catalyst: Whatever happened after the Battle of Dias, Suleiman believes he was betrayed by his nation and grew disillusioned as a result with a hard time trusting others.

characters.name: "Man-Eater" Bartolomeo
characters.description: A Super Rookie and the captain of the Bartolomeo Club that became a contender of the Corrida Colosseum. He won the Block B battle and basically acts like aHeel. He has eaten the Barrier-Barrier Fruit (Bari Bari no Mi), which allows him to generate indestructible barriers at will.Despite his rough appearance, he is actually anextremelyenthusiastic and dedicated fanboy of none other than the Straw Hat Pirates (Luffy and Zoro in particular), having followed their exploits since their time in Logue Town. So naturally, when he finally meets them in Dressrosa, he makes for an immediately valuable ally in the fight against Doflamingo.His epithet, "Man-Eater", deserves some slight explanation. He doesn't (as far as we know) have a penchant for eating human flesh; instead it's a Japanese saying that references the fact that spending time with Bartolomeo, who is incredibly abrasive and annoying, is roughly akin to him slowly eating you alive. In English, the closest turn of phrase would be asking someone "what's eating you?" if they're annoyed, which also goes well with it.He has a bounty of 200,000,000 Berries. After Doflamingo's defeat, he and his crew become, through lottery with their allies, the 2nd division of Luffy's fleet. Achievements in Ignorance: The Straw Hat discover to their dismay that Bartolomeo didn't even recruit a navigator to sail the Grand Line.Even Luffy wasn't that moronic. The best they did was to regularly call Gambia's grandmother, who gives them tips, but only of the household cleaning and first aid variety. How he got past his first island, let alone reached the New World and survived is left to the readers to decipher. Achilles' Heel: His barriers are completely impenetrable, but he does have several limitations and weaknesses: he has an upper limit to how much surface area of barriers he can create at once, and while his barriers are nearly-indestructible, they are not completely immovable by outside forces, as seen as when he's pushed back by Do

characters.name: Other Members of the Barto Club
characters.description: Ascended Fanboy: Like their boss, they join the Straw hats and become members of their fleet, something that is a dream come true for them. Childhood Friends: In SBS Volume 81, it's revealed that the Barto Club started as a group of rascals who grew up as childhood friends in rural areas, and increased in size later on until eventually they became a gang. Among them, the current members are made up of the elites that love the Straw Hat Pirates and left home and went to sea. Fanboy: They're just as crazy about Luffy as their captain. Too Dumb to Live: The fact that they don't have a navigator, are more incompetent at sea than Luffy originally was, and that they take dumb advice from a woman who hasn't been to sea proves that they must be luckier than the Straw Hats to have been able to reach the New World. Uncertain Doom:Unlike the Kid pirates who are stated to be completely obliterated. The narration states that it's unknown if there are any survivors from the Barto Club after Yasopp blows up their ship.

characters.name: Don Sai
characters.description: The elder grandson of Don Chinjao, a member of the Chinjao Family and the 13th leader of the Happo Navy. He is a participant in the Corrida Coliseum along with Chinjao and his brother Boo. The three have a hidden agenda to investigate a weapons trade that the Donquixote Family was involved in.Once his grandfather pledges his loyalty to Luffy, Sai quickly follows suit and helps in the battle against Doflamingo. After proving that he's become stronger than his grandfather, Don Chinjao, the latter nominates Sai the new leader of the Happo Navy.After Doflamingo's defeat, he and the Happo Navy become, through lottery with their allies, the 3rd division of Luffy's fleet. His bounty is of 210,000,000 Berries. Apologises a Lot: Goes down on his knees and begs for forgiveness from a Colosseum doctor despite having already apologized three times. Arranged Marriage: He was arranged by his grandpa to marry the daughter of the Nippo Navy's general, in order to merge the two navies together. Though he releases Sai from it after the latter proves his worth by breaking his drill head. Asskicking Leads to Leadership: After Sai nonchalantly bends his pointy head, unintentionally proving that he's become stronger, Don Chinjao says that Sai has earned the right to become the new captain of the Happo Navy.

characters.name: Boo
characters.description: Don Chinjao's younger grandson, a member of the Chinjao Family and vice-leader of the Happo Navy under Sai. He participates in the Corrida Colosseum tournament but gets defeated by the Funky Brothers. Face of a Thug: Like his brother, he's not exactly a looker but remains a good person at heart. Number Two: He is Sai's younger brother and his vice-leader. Stout Strength: He's pudgy, but still muscular. Straight Man: Often acts more serious when his older brother becomes overly emotional.

characters.name: Don Chinjao "The Drill"
characters.description: A former pirate and leader of the Happo Navy and a participant in the Corrida Colosseum. He holds a grudge against Garp for having squashed his characteristic pointy head. He extends this grudge onto Garp's grandson Luffy, but Luffy accidentally makes his head pointy again and Chinjao vows loyalty to him. After seeing that his own grandson Sai has surpassed him, Don Chinjao decides to retire and nominates Sai the new leader of the Happo Navy.Despite his age, Don Chinjao is still a formidable fighter, proving to be Luffy's first true challenge of the New World, and mainly fights using his head which, in the past, was pointy and strong enough to split an entire continent. He's also one of the few who possesses Conqueror's Haki.Being formerly one of the most dangerous pirates, he has a bounty of 542,000,000 Berry. Always Someone Better: Garp was stronger than him and broke Chinjao's legend to rubble, something he's still bitter about many years after the fact to the point he would have killed even a young Dragon had he known he was Garp's son. Annoying Arrows: When Luffy dodges all of Jean Ango's projectile weapons with Observation Haki, they end up lodged in Chinjao's gut. All this does is make him mad; he then headbutts Jean away from the ring. Arranged Marriage: He had planned to marry off his grandson Sai to the daughter of the leader of the Nippo Navy. The plan being that their two navies, the Happo (which has the Japanese word for 8) and the Nippo (which has the word for 2), would be merged and become a stronger new one called Jappo Navy (which has the word for 10). But when Sai managed to prove his worth (by breaking his drill head), he decides to release Sai from the marriage and let him choose for himself. Arrogant Kung-Fu Guy: Was incredibly confident and boastful of his head's supposed invincibility, causing him to directly ram it into Garp's fist.

characters.name: Baby  5
characters.description: Baby 5 is a character who is originally introduced as a servant and assassin of the Donquixote Pirates. Specifically, she's an officer of the Pica Army, the commando division. She has eaten the Arms-Arms Fruit (Buki Buki no Mi) that allows her to turn her body(parts) into any kind of weapon she likes.She later defects from the Donquixote Pirates prior to their downfall after Sai vows to make her his wife if he defeats Lao G. Abusive Parents:Her own mother rejected her in the light of her kin viewing Baby 5 asThe Loadamong them and wanting to cut the dead weight. As for her father, no one knows if he was ever even part of the picture. Action Bomb: Her Missile Girl technique, which turns her entire body into a missile, but her ability to reform herself after exploding makes this a reusable tactic. Anatomy Arsenal: She ate the Arms-Arms Fruit (Buki Buki no Mi) that allows her to turn her body(parts) or her entire body into weapons, both bladed and firearms. Arm Cannon: Literally, Baby 5 can turn her arms into cannons or pistols thanks to her Devil Fruit power.

characters.name: Ideo, "Cannon of Destruction"
characters.description: One of the participants of the Corrida Colosseum's tournament for the Flame-Flame Fruit. A triple-X ranked Boxer who has won the New World Central Fighting Tournament twice. He's also part of the Longarm Tribe.After Doflamingo's defeat, he, Blue Gilly, Abdullah, and Jeet form the XXX Gym Martial Arts Alliance with him as the leader, and through lottery with their allies, become the 4th division of Luffy's fleet. Adaptation Dye-Job: His black hair in the manga becomes dark purple in the anime. Blood Knight: Implied, in the coverstory, Ideo gladly sends his crew, consisting of four people, to attack two ships embroiled in a heated battle. Boxing Battler: Ideo is a long-arm who fights exclusively with his fists, usually extending his arms for a more powerful punch. Creepily Long Arms: As typical of a Longarm, although one of his joints is compressed on his shoulders, which gives the impression of normal arms but long shoulders instead. Also downplayed as he's not really that creepy. He can, however, extend his arms to their normal length.

characters.name: Blue Gilly
characters.description: A blue-haired member of the Longleg Tribe and an accomplished martial artist who participated in the Corrida Colosseum tournament for the Flame-Flame Fruit.After the battle for Dressrosa, he forms the XXX Gym Martial Arts Alliance alongside Ideo, Abdullah and Jeet. Bruce Lee Clone: Not only is his name similar, he also has the characteristichigh-pitched yells as well. Double Agent: He was originally working along with Dagama in the fight to take out the weaker fighters in the block,with Dagama planning to kill him as soon as his back was turned. However, Blue Gilly knew all along that Dagama was planning to betray him, so he attacked and defeated him at the last moment. Extremity Extremist: As expected from a Longleg, he fights only with his legs, through a Longleg-exclusive fighting style called "Jao Kun Do". It's a pretty effective fighting style, and his kicks are compared to steel whips. Mr. Fanservice: He's a handsome man whose clothing consists of an open shirt and a speedo, showing off his toned physique and long, muscular legs.

characters.name: Abdullah
characters.description: A criminal who alongside Jeet used to be a bounty hunter and participates in the Corrida Colosseum tournament.After the battle of Dressrosa, he forms the XXX Gym Martial Arts Alliance alongside Jeet, Ideo, and Blue Gilly. Bash Brothers: With Jeet they punch above their weight in the Colosseum through well-coordinated teamwork and very dirty fighting. Big Damn Heroes:Abdullah and Jeet come just in time to save Luffy, Law, and Ucy from Doflamingo's string clone when they are sent in a trap set up by the Funk Brothers. Bullying a Dragon: In their bounty hunter days, he and Jeet tried to collect on Bartholomew Kuma's 296,000,000 Berry bounty and got their ship instantly wrecked. Continuity Cameo: In the past, he and Jeet have a brief cameo in chapter 1100, where they tried to go after Kuma's bounty while he was traveling the world.

characters.name: Jeet
characters.description: A criminal who alongside Abdullah used to be a bounty hunter and participates in the Corrida Colosseum tournament.After the battle of Dressrosa, he forms the XXX Gym Martial Arts Alliance alongside Abdullah, Ideo, and Blue Gilly. Bash Brothers: With Abdullah they advance through the Corrida Colosseum tournament through strong teamwork. Big Damn Heroes:Jeet and Abdullah come just in time to save Luffy, Law, and Ucy from Doflamingo's string clone when they are sent in a trap set up by the Funk Brothers. Combat Pragmatist: Not above attacking someone from behind while Abdullah is keeping them busy. Continuity Cameo: In the past, he and Abdullah have a brief cameo in chapter 1100, where they tried to go after Kuma's bounty while he was traveling the world.

characters.name: "Warrior" Leo
characters.description: The top warrior of the Tontatta, a tribe of Dwarves that lives on Green Bit. He leads the Dwarves against Doflamingo in order to liberate Dressrosa and 500 other Dwarves, including their princess Mansherry, that were captured and enslaved to work in Doflamingo's SMILE factory. He has eaten the Sew-Sew Fruit (Nui Nui no Mi) which allows him to sew things together without causing any harm to the things in question.After Doflamingo's defeat, he with several Tontatta become, through lottery with their allies, the 5th division of Luffy's fleet. Berserk Button: Mild example, but he took offense to Vivi calling him cute, calling it unfit for warriors like him; though he quickly came around to it when she apologized (and that doesn't stop her from thinking he's cute). Belligerent Sexual Tension: With Mansherry. She's atsundere, he's insensitive and brash. Bridal Carry: Invoked by Mansherry, who tells him that she's too hurt to walk. Leo comments that she's fine but, after some insistence, he carries her. BFG: Played with. He has been seen carrying a normal-sized pistol with him, but because of his miniature size, it ends up being larger than him.

characters.name: Bian
characters.description: A member of the Tonta Corps who serves as the leader of the Pink Bee Squad. She has eaten the Bug-Bug Fruit (Mushi Mushi no Mi), Model: Hornet. Animorphism: She ate a Zoan Devil Fruit, namely the Bug-Bug Fruit, Mode: Hornet. Bee Afraid: Bian can turn into a bee and commands swarms of bees. Flight: In her hybrid form, she can fly. Masculine Lines, Feminine Curves: Unlike the more stocky male Dwarves, Bian has a much more slender and curvaceous body.

characters.name: Kabu
characters.description: The leader of the Yellow Kabu Squad. He has eaten the Bug-Bug Fruit (Mushi Mushi no Mi), Model: Rhinoceros Beetle. Animorphism: He ate a Zoan Devil Fruit, namely the Bug-Bug Fruit, Model: Rhinoceros Beetle. Coat Cape: Wears an orange cape on his back. Curb-Stomp Battle: He's easily rendered unconscious by Gladius. Flight: In his hybrid form, he can fly.

characters.name: Wicka
characters.description: A dwarf in the Tontatta Tribe's Scouting Unit who steals Zoro's sword, eventually leading him to the Tontatta Kingdom. She later becomes a member of the Tonta Corps after the Straw Hats leave Dressrosa. Badass Adorable: Wicka is arguably one of the cutest dwarves (which says a lot) but can also break rocks with her raw strength. Badass Normal: Wicka is only named member of The Tontatta Pirates who lacks a Devil Fruit power, but not only is she just as much anBadass Adorableas the rest of them but she actually might be the strongest in terms of raw strength. Brutal Honesty: She doesn't hesitate to insultZorofor having trouble following her simple directions to Green Bit. Curtains Match the Window: Her main color is blue, as all her clothes are blue, and this means her eyes and hair too.

characters.name: "Pirate Mercenary" Hajrudin
characters.description: AGiantfrom Elbaph, part of a new generation of warriors from there. He's a participant of the Corrida Colosseum. Hajrudin wishes to be king of the Giants and also reform the legendary Giant Warrior Pirates, once led by Dorry & Brogy. He also was a member of Buggy's Pirate Dispatch Organization, being an S-ranked soldier, having since resigned.After Doflamingo's defeat, he and his crew become, through lottery with their allies, the 6th division of Luffy's fleet. Afterwards, Hajrudin and his crew meet the Straw Hats again inElbaph, where he plays an important role in continuing the will of king Harald. Arrogant Kung-Fu Guy: At first, he's very proud of his giant heritage and looks down on other races, then he mellows down after being defeated by Luffy. Badass Cape: After leaving Buggy's organization, Hajrudin wears a large fur cape befitting a proud giant warrior. His fellow giant warriors that make up his crew also wear capes. Badass Normal: He might be a giant, but he has no Devil Fruit and fights only with his trained skill and strength. Notable in comparison to his brother who uses Elbaph's Forbidden Devil Fruit. Barbarian Long Hair:Exaggerated. Not only does Hajrudin have a wide, unruly and spiky mane of brown locks that goes past his hips, visually communicating that he's a fierce warrior, but his hair is even larger than him, a 22 meter tall giant.

characters.name: Stansen
characters.description: The crew's shipwright. He's first seen as a prisoner in the Auction House in Sabaody until he's saved by Silvers Rayleigh. An Arm and a Leg:Imu chops off his right leg when he kicks Hajrudin out of the way. Bait-and-Switch: In the anime, after Disco loses consciousness from the Color of the Supreme King's Haki, the camera zooms up slowly on Stansen, making the audience think for a brief momentif he could have something to do with it. Then his eyes move to his down-right and he talks to the old man below that he has figured out that it's said old man's doing. Said old man is the coating craftsman the Straw Hats have been looking for, and he's also revealed to be the right-hand man of the Pirate King. The manga doesn't do the reveal in this manner, where it's done much more quickly. Barefoot Captives: He's barefoot in the anime, when he's being captive as a would-be-slave. Not in the manga, where he wears boots. Carry a Big Stick: As a member of Hajrudin's crew, Stansen wields a giant sized warhammer as a weapon.

characters.name: Road
characters.description: The crew's navigator. One of his hobbies is ruling over a make-believe world cosplaying as the Sun God, where he keeps humans as playthings and has many giant pets roaming his domain. His personality is a combination of odious and sheepish, making it a challenge to befriend him without grimacing at his less venerable traits, but Road is indeed a noble Giant when the situation calls for it. Accidental Hero: It's implied that Road's pet crow captured the Cipher Pol agents sent to Elbaph by the Holy Knights, meaning that he kept the Knights from getting any real info on Elbaph by imprisoning them in hisBuilt with LEGOmodel. All of the Other Reindeer: Road was shunned by other kids when he was young because they found his hobbies too nerdy. The first one to actually be nice to him was Hajrudin, who complimented his drawing skills and became his first friend. Animal Lover: Implied. While he never acts particularly caring towards them, Road has a lot of giant-sized pets that he keeps in his room to act as guardians or play the role of gods towards his "dolls". Bait-and-Switch: Road dresses and passes himself off as the Sun God to the humans he kidnaps. He initially seems like he'll be theArc Villainof the Elbaph Arc, but the Straw Hats have no trouble fending him off, and by the time the rest of the crew arrives, he gets unceremoniously beaten by his fellow crewmates Gerd and Goldberg. He serves as an ally instead for the rest of the arc, with the true arc villains being the Knights of God.

characters.name: Goldberg
characters.description: Ancestral Weapon:Downplayed, his shield, Nash, was his father's who had it with him when he left with a crew of Giants to hunt down Big Mom. Obviously, they were unsuccessful and Nash ended up becoming aHomie. Big Fun: Goldberg is very fat and he seems to be a cheerful giant who gets along well with his crewmates. When hehits Road, it's not Goldberg's fault at all, and he never shows hostility to his other crewmates and the Straw Hats. Carry a Big Stick: He wields a giant sized spiked club along with his shield. Chef of Iron: He is a warrior and the chef of the giant crew. Exposed to the Elements: Walks shirtless around even in the freezing cold of Elbaph’s underworld not feeling the cold.

characters.name: Gerd
characters.description: The crew's doctor. During her childhood in Elbaph, she was Big Mom's friend. She has a sweet spot for humans, considering them adorable due to their size difference to Giants, and likes to make clothes for them to wear. Awesomeness by Analysis: Gerd is able to analyze the wounds of the guards attacked bythe Holy Knights, correctly deducing how they got hurt, after quickly healing them. She's also able to see if someone is lying. Beauty Is Never Tarnished:When she and her crew are falling from high up in the sky, Luffy uses his Gum-Gum Balloon technique to cushion their fall. As he catches them, Gerd conveniently falls off the ship safely on the ground, which saves her when the ship and the rest of the crew are launched in the air thanks to Luffy acting as a makeshift spring, letting her avoid the injuries the men get, like bloodied faces, a bump on the head and missing teeth.Horrifyingly subverted when Imu lops off her fingertips, serving as a rare instance where a female character suffers mutilating injury in the series. Thankfully, Chopper reattaches them. When she and her crew are falling from high up in the sky, Luffy uses his Gum-Gum Balloon technique to cushion their fall. As he catches them, Gerd conveniently falls off the ship safely on the ground, which saves her when the ship and the rest of the crew are launched in the air thanks to Luffy acting as a makeshift spring, letting her avoid the injuries the men get, like bloodied faces, a bump on the head and missing teeth. Horrifyingly subverted when Imu lops off her fingertips, serving as a rare instance where a female character suffers mutilating injury in the series. Thankfully, Chopper reattaches them.

characters.name: Commodore Orlumbus "The Savage Surmounter"
characters.description: One of the participants of the Corrida Colosseum's tournament. An adventurer and "made-up" explorer who commands the Yonta Maria Grand Fleet, with over 4300 members.After Doflamingo's defeat, he and his fleet become, through lottery with their allies, the 7th division of Luffy's fleet.He has a bounty of 148,000,000 Berry. Badass Army: His Yonta Maria Grand Fleet is comprised of a staggering 4300 members, which means more than 3/4 of the members of the Straw Hat Grand Fleet are under his command. Badass Longcoat: He wears a longcoat andnothing else underneaththat highlights his already impressive bulk. Baritone of Strength: Orlumbus' voice is extremely deep and is powerful enough to make enemy mooks obey his orders. He usually uses it to make them stand in order, like bowling pins, before throwing another mook at them. Bavarian Fire Drill: HisCommodore's Dignityconsists of him yelling commands at the top of his lungs in a demanding way, causing people to be tricked into obeying his commands. He usually uses it to have his enemies aligned for hisAdmiral's Killer Bowling.

characters.name: Columbus
characters.description: Orlumbus'sNumber Twoand the second in command of the Yonta Maria fleet. In contrast to Admiral Orlumbus, she's a short girl with a very bad temper. Huge Guy, Tiny Girl: An extreme case, as she's a very short girl while Orlumbus is more than twelve feet tall and nearly as wide. Neat Freak: Columbus prefers the dock to be very clean just like Orlumbus, but even more extreme in her case, since she even beats those who don't do well the cleaning performances. No Historical Figures Were Harmed: Downplayed, but she too takes some inspirations from Christopher Columbus, and even has the same name. Number Two: She's Orlumbus's second in command and they contrast with each other, with one being big and, overall, nice, and the other being tiny and short-tempered. Their names are also a pun on their sizes.

characters.name: Saint Roswald Roswald
characters.description: A noble who is the father of Charlos and Shalria. All There in the Manual: His full name is revealed in SBS 113 as Roswald Roswald. Beard of Evil: Has a large fluffy beard and is no less evil than the rest of his social class. Classy Cane: Carries a literal wooden cane to walk on. The Collector: Has a thing for gathering up slaves that were once Pirate Captains, including Devil Dias and Jean Bart.

characters.name: Saint Roswald Charlos
characters.description: One of the nobles Zoro encountered in the Sabaody Archipelago arc, though Zoro didn't know who he was at the time and mistook him for a lost stranger looking for directions. He is Shalria's older brother and the son of Roswald, though far more spoiled and bratty than his sibling. Asshole Victim:Admit it, you were celebrating when Sai and Leo caved his skull in. Bullying a Dragon: In the Sabaody Archipelago, Saint Charlos wastes no time in bragging about how he shot Hatchan in front of aclearly pissed offLuffy, and despite outright noting Luffy's rage wastes no time trying to shoot him, with utterlypredictable resultshappening soon after. The Bus Came Back: After his helping ofLaser-Guided Karma, he returns to the story in the Reverie Arc, where he sets his sights on Shirahoshi — and promptly receivesanotherwell-deserved dose ofLaser-Guided Karma. And then, after not learning his lesson when Mjosgard clobbered him, he promptly getsSquashed Flatby Don Sai and Leo after they get Mjosgard's permission to hit Charlos. Butt-Monkey: Out of all the Celestial Dragons, Charlos gets attacked a total of three times, although that's not sayinghe doesn't deserve it. Him being aDirty Cowarddoesn't help his case.

characters.name: Saint Roswald Shalria
characters.description: A female noble, who appeared in the Sabaody Archipelago arc. She is the daughter of Roswald, and she shares her people's collective arrogance and depravity. Beauty Is Bad: She's one of the few conventionally attractive World Nobles, but she's just as morally depraved as her brother and father. Even Evil Has Loved Ones: Murderous slaver she may be, Shalria does legitimately care for her brother and father. She reacts with genuine horror to them being hurt by Luffy and Usopp respectively and furiously vows revenge on the Straw Hats after they escape. Evil Brit: She has a British accent in theFUNimationdub. Kick the Dog: Tried to shoot Camie just to take away the Straw Hats' prize.

characters.name: Saint Jalmack
characters.description: A noble that visited Goa Kingdom ten years before the start of the series, and was the one responsible for sinking Sabo's ship. BFG: Uses a large bazooka to sink Sabo's ship. Create Your Own Hero: If Jalmack had just let Sabo go, he probably would have gone on to become a notorious pirate with an axe to grind with nobles but no more of a personal nemesis than any other infamous pirate. Sinking his ship instead led him right into the arms of Dragon and radicalized him against the World Government so much that in the present his goal in life is to actively see the government torn apart and make people like Jalmack face true justice, and he's more than capable of achieving that goal. Disproportionate Retribution: A little boy flying a pirate flag and dared to sail in Jalmack's path gets blasted with a bazooka. Karma Houdini: Gets away with blasting a pirate ship with Sabo inside of it because his ship crossed his path, but he claims it's because Sabo raised a pirate flag.

characters.name: Saint Donquixote Mjosgard
characters.description: A male World Noble. He visited Fish-Man Island eight years before the story started, in a failed attempt to retrieve his escaped Fishmen slaves. When he went back to Marie Geoise, Queen Otohime asked follow him, so that she can acquire the right for the Ryugu Kingdom to participate in the Reverie. In the present time, he's changed to a different person than what he was before and is revealed to be a member of the Donquixote family. Ambiguously Related: It's mentioned that the World Nobles have started to think the Donquixote Family is weird when you look at Mjosgard's actions with Homing's, which does imply a connection between the men. The exact relationship with how Mjosgard relates to Homing, Rocinante, and Doflamingo is unknown. Arrested for Heroism: It's implied Celestial Dragons are allowed to fight and even kill one another, as Charlos had no compunction ordering Kuma to kill Mjosgard and faced no punishment for it. Mjosgad's true "crime" that sees him arrested and sentenced to death is "standing up for subhuman scum." Armor-Piercing Response: When he demands if his old slaves know who he is, they bring up his Admiral protection is only good if someone knows about it and on the ocean floor he'll be just another shipwrecked corpse. This makes Mjosgard realize how dire his situation is. The Atoner: What little we see of Mjosgard before hisHeel–Face Turnisnotgood. He was a heartless slaver who badly wanted to keep Fish Men as pets and he and his father have a collection of beautiful women in chains who look very unhappy to be there. After his turn to good thanks to Otohime, Mjosgard hates the man he used to be and resolves to be worthy of Otohime's faith in him to make up for his misdeeds.He ultimately dies saving her children.

characters.name: Saint Donquixote Shivercalero
characters.description: A noble who is the father of Mjosgard. Adaptational Villainy: Slightly. In the manga, he simply informs Mjosgard of the political developments of Fish-Men freedom. The anime shows him demonstrating more visceral disgust and anger at their freedom while approving of Mjosgard attempting to recapture them. Bald of Evil: His head is balding and is no less evil then his fellow World Nobles are, as he grumbles about Fish-Men being set free from slavery. Carpet of Virility: His white robe exposes his chest, showing that he’s very hairy underneath. Even Evil Has Loved Ones: His and Mjosgard's past only good qualities was them genuinely seeming to care about one another. If he lived to see Mjosgard becoming a better person, his thoughts on it are unknown.

characters.name: Saint Donquixote Homing
characters.description: A World Noble who treated commoners much better than the rest of the nobles. He and his family stepped down from their positions before the series began, inadvertently leading to Doflamingo'sStart of Darkness. Abusive Parents:Subverted. When Doflamingo mentions his father early on in the Dressrosa arc, his words imply that Homing must have done something truly heinous to shape Doflamingo into the monster he is today. Then he appears in Doflamingo's flashback, where he's presented asone of the very few good-hearted Celestial Dragons. Beauty Equals Goodness: Not exactly physical beauty, but he and his wife have rather gentle countenances in contrast to the Celestial Dragons' default smug expression. They're also among the very few Celestial Dragons depicted as genuinely nice, with Homing even proclaiming that he is a mere human and giving up his status to live a humble life. Unfortunately, his humility was marred with naivete and ignorance (much like every other Celestial Dragon) on how much the common peopledespisedthe Celestial Dragons. His wife was poised enough to apologize to her children for not being in good health, despite the horrible conditions they were forced into. Boom, Headshot!: Dies whenhis son Doflamingoshoots him in the head. Break the Cutie: Homing was a gentle, sweet man who had the best intentions. By the end, he's so broken by endless pursuit, hard living and torture that he can only apologize to his sons for his failure before one of them murders him.

characters.name: Saint Pluming
characters.description: One of several nobles who are seen during the Reverie, when the Revolutionary Army attacks Marijoa. Choice of Two Weapons: He uses both a pistol and a whip as his weapons, not that he’s much of a fighter. Dastardly Whiplash: He has a thin curly mustache which emphasizes what a cruel and evil person Pluming is. Dirty Coward: When he sees his agents have been defeated by Karasu, Pluming decides to run for his life while screaming in utter terror. Gonk: Pluming is not what one would call handsome, which ranges from his unflattering bob cut hairstyle to his upper mouth only having one pair of buck teeth and nothing else.

characters.name: Baskerville
characters.description: The Chief Justice of Enies Lobby who appears as a three-headed man. In reality, he's three people who are acting as one body. The left head is Bas, his right is Kerville, and his middle is And. Cloud Cuckoo Lander: Baskerville's middle head is bizarre compared to the other two, coming up with weird compromises such as requesting executions for criminals or giving himself extravagant titles. All three are weird to some degree as they're actually three people who love pretending to be one person with three heads. Hanging Judge: His left (who wants the verdict to be punished with incredible torture) and central head (who always gives death penalty) give rather severe sentences to anyone they accuse, regardless of their innocence. Insane Troll Logic: While Baskerville's left head almost always declares the accused as guilty and Baskerville's right head almost always declares the accused as innocent, Baskerville's middle head insists on offering a "compromise" between the other two. However, his idea for a compromise isexecution, which is as extreme of a punishment as possible. Multiple Head Case: Subverted. At first, it appears that Baskerville has three heads, each with their own different personality. However, they're actually three peoplesharing one shirtsimplybecause they're friends.

characters.name: Kong
characters.description: Twenty years ago, at the dawn of the Golden Age of Piracy, Kong was the Fleet Admiral. He's since been promoted. Now one of the most powerful people in the World Government, Kong's authority extends to not just the Marines but the Warlords, espionage agents, Cipher Pols, and Impel Down and Enies Lobby staff as well. Anime Hair: Kong has as a spiky hairstyle that looks more like a mountain range than the top of someone's head, with a similarly spiked beard. Anti-Villain: Kong is an honorable man who's respected by his subordinates and truly cares for the marines and their reputation while also being more reasonable than a number of racist subordinates. He's still in charge of the worst aspects of the military, such as Cipher Pol, as well as tacitly allowing the Seven Warlord system to flourish and being complicit in worse deeds. The Elbaph flashback reveals Kong is involved in deep corruption as Admiral, knowing of and covering up the brutal Manhunt Competition even if he's personally far from evil himself. Authority Sounds Deep: Fitting for a man in charge of the strongest military in the world, Kong has a very deep and authoritative voice in sub and dub alike. Beleaguered Boss: To be expected from a guy who had to command Garp, Kong is shown exasperated by him in flashbacks and has to all but beg him to intervene at God Valley.

characters.name: # — E
characters.description: 13 Is Unlucky: It's stated that there are only 13 individuals permitted to form an "Abyss" and "Depths" covenant with Imu and know of his existence, indicated to be reserved solely for the Elders and Holy Knights. Abusive Precursors: Imu is the "Creator," referred to as the one who created the World Government and is implied to have been the leader of the First Twenty. This makes him responsible for the horrific system of exploitation and elitism the Celestial Dragons perpetuate which has caused so much misery to the people of the world for centuries. Achilles' Heel:Conqueror's Haki applied in a specific way is the only known thing that can bypass the immortality Imu's powers grant to others. Imu being brought to his knees by Joy Boy's Haki due to his connection to the Five Elders when he was hit with it implies Imu himself isn't exempt, but is so powerful and has such strong Haki of his own that he can defend himself from any lesser Haki infused attack.Imu's Covenants are a double-edged sword, as for all the benefits, Imu himself will suffer some kind of backlash should one of his slaves actually be killed off by anyone except Imu himself. Imu being brought to his knees by Joy Boy's Haki due to his connection to the Five Elders when he was hit with it implies Imu himself isn't exempt, but is so powerful and has such strong Haki of his own that he can defend himself from any lesser Haki infused attack. Imu's Covenants are a double-edged sword, as for all the benefits, Imu himself will suffer some kind of backlash should one of his slaves actually be killed off by anyone except Imu himself.

characters.name: Saint Jaygarcia Saturn
characters.description: The first of the Five Elders to be formally introduced and fleshed out. Jaygarcia Saturn is the Godhead of Science and Defense. Arch-Enemy:The Egghead arc reveals Saturn to be the arch-enemy of Bartholomew Kuma. While Kuma has been in conflict with the World Government from a young age, the one enemy that he's persistently been involved with is Saturn, who has been a looming presence in his life since the day they first met, when he was a child slave in God Valley. Saturn, in turn, seems to have a particular focus on squashing Kuma as "punishment" for him being both born of the Buccaneer race as well as upholding the folklore of Sun God Nika and his ideals of freedom. This animosity between them later passes on to Kuma's adoptive daughter, Bonney, who blames Saturn for Kuma's full conversion into a cyborg, an act that functionally killed her father, and causes Bonney to try and kill Saturn in turn. To cement this hatred, Saturn reveals to her thatheis the reason why Bonney contracted the Sapphire Scales disease that her father gave up his life to save her from, as they were the result of Saturn's experiments on her mother Ginny while she was held captive as a slave wife. Everything that has gone wrong in Kuma's adult life, and by extension Bonney'sentirelife, can be attributed to Saturn and his sheer disregard for those he deems "human".Saturn harbors a deep resentment towardsNika, specifically the very concept of him. Whilst Imu and the rest of the Elders are in natural opposition to the Sun God, Saturn has taken personal effort to try and undo Nika's very existence, showing a targeted focus on destroying those who espouse the ideals of theHope Bringerin the cruelest manner possible, in order todissuade others from believing in him. As the Devil Fruit is apparently born from the hopes and dreams of those seeking freedom, crushing their spirits before their death helps lower the chance of Nika's continued existence, with Saturn showing a vested interest inbreaking B

characters.name: Saint Marcus Mars
characters.description: Marcus Mars is the Godhead of Environment. Alliterative Name:MarcusMars. Beard of Evil: He's got a long beard, shaped like a trident, adding points to his villainous design. Breath Weapon:In his Itsumade form, he can fire a beam of energy from his mouth that is powerful enough to destroy a significant portion of Vegapunk's lab. Bright Is Not Good: His arrival to Lucci is heralded by dazzling light and his official coloring is extremely colorful and shiny. Naturally, he's just as evil as his compatriots.

characters.name: Saint Topman Warcury
characters.description: The seemingly oldest of the Five Elders, alongside V. Nusjuro, Topman Warcury is the Godhead of Justice. Badass Boast: Upon confronting the Giant Warrior pirates, Warcury sneers he'll show them his power to drive in the futility of escape and break the will of his opponents, just before he lets loose with a howl of Conqueror's Haki. Bald of Evil: He's got a bald head, which highlights his malicious ways of thought. Beard of Evil: He's got a long and thick mustache that sticks out from his face, similar to Whitebeard's, but it's much longer, thicker and wavier. It almost looks like a weapon.When transformed into a Fengxi, his tusks resemble his mustache, and because of that, the silhouette of his transformation during the Reverie made it easier to identify him. Brutal Honesty: When Cobra asks if renouncing what he saw and answering Imu about the Nefeltari family would spare him, Warcury immediately comments that Cobra was a dead man walking the second he saw Imu and lying about it would change nothing.

characters.name: Saint Ethanbaron V. Nusjuro
characters.description: The only member of the Five Elders seen wielding a weapon, Ethanbaron V. Nusjuro is the Godhead of Finance. Bald of Evil: He's old, bald, and a prominent member of the Five Elders, the leaders of the corrupted World Government. The bald head makes him look more cunning. He is also the only one of them that doesn't have any facial hair. Blade Enthusiast: Nusjuro wields one of the finest swords in the world and is usually shown caring for it with surprising diligence. He's also highly knowledgable about swords, instantly recognizing Zoro's Sandai Kitetsu in one clash. Call a Human a "Meatbag": He starts referring to his opponents as "bio-response" when he and the others get truly furious about all their efforts unraveling, further emphasizing how they view humans as beneath them. Cool Sword: The katana he wields is a part of theKitetsu line, as he and Zoro recognize each others' swords when the pair clash. While not confirmed in the manga, his Ichiban Kuji One Piece "Future Island Egghead - Burst of Energy" figure would refer to it as Shodai Kitetsu, one of the Supreme Blades.

characters.name: Saint Shepherd Ju Peter
characters.description: The seemingly youngest of the Five Elders, Shepherd Ju Peter is the Godhead of Agriculture. Adaptational Dye-Job: The anime portrays Ju Peter with blond hair, making him appear younger than his fellow Elders. When he's shown in color in the manga, his hair is white despite his comparatively youthful looks Ambiguously Related: One of the Holy Knights is named St. Shepherd Sommers and has a noticeable resemblance to Ju Peter. Any blood relation despite presumably being of the same ancient World Noble house is unknown. Bait the Dog: Ju Peter sucks up the Cipher Pol members to save them from falling, giving some indication he's a decent enough boss after Mars casually remarked he wasn't going to even bother to make an attempt to spare his agents. Then Ju Peter just spits them at the enemy with no care for their lives as soon as the situation arises, demonstrating how hereallyfeels about them. Creepy Cool Crosses: In his name: the "Ju" in Ju Peter is written with 十, the kanji for "ten", which is shaped like a cross and therefore also used to refer to crosses (Juji, literally "Ten-Shaped"). Fits with the general divine motif of the Celestial Dragons.
